findings.summary: The '123 מקורו / 123 מחושב' legend is confusing; the reader didn't know what source vs calculated meant for their money, so they ignored it.
Scrolling through all 143 rows of the table was tiring.
The teal and yellow exposure rings and the 'מט"ח' figure weren't understood: the reader didn't know what the ring shows or whether 99% foreign currency means more risk.
'מניות 101%' (Meitav) puzzled the reader: how can exposure be more than 100%?
The difference between the fee 'מהחיסכון' and 'מההפקדות' isn't explained; the reader had to guess.
'עוד לא דווח' / 'השדה ריק בנתוני הרשות' is unclear: which authority is meant, and why is the field empty?
Jargon such as 'גמיש' and 'סחיר' in track names isn't explained.
The reader wasn't sure whether the 3-year return (e.g. 13.5%) is per year or in total; per year sounded too good to be true.
Nothing helps the reader choose a track for their age or time horizon (for example 'כללי' vs 'עד 25% מניות'), which is why they were only 6/10 sure.
Missing information: the return after fees and tax, worst-year figures, rules at 60+ and the monthly pension option, withdrawal terms, switching costs, and whether the fee can be negotiated.
